name: password-manager
description: Local-first desktop password manager built with Electron, React, and SQLite.
author: lugep

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:api && concurrently -n web,electron -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm --workspace apps/electron run dev"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/web run dev
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/api run dev
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/api run build
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/electron run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/web run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm --workspace apps/electron run build
scripts.build:web:tauri: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/web run build:tauri
scripts.build:tauri: npm run build:web:tauri && cargo build --release -p cipher-vault
scripts.test:rust-parity: npm run build:api && cargo test -p cipher-vault-core --test node_parity -- --ignored
scripts.test:tauri-shell: npm run build:web:tauri && cargo build -p cipher-vault --features e2e && node scripts/verify-tauri-shell.mjs target/debug/cipher-vault.exe target/e2e-screenshots
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.test:security: npm run build:desktop && node --test tests/renderer-security.test.mjs tests/renderer-hardening.test.mjs
scripts.test:sessions: npm run build:api && npm run build:electron && node --import tsx --test tests/vault-session.test.mjs tests/web-session.test.mjs tests/vault-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/vault-kdf.test.mjs tests/input-validation.test.mjs tests/expiring-clipboard.test.mjs tests/desktop-platform.test.mjs
